runs.name: choose
runs.command: thinkthen choose 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < ticket.txt
runs.input:
I renewed once this morning, but my card shows two charges.
Please refund the duplicate.

runs.name: choose-answer
runs.command: thinkthen choose --details 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < ticket.txt | jq '.answer.probabilities'
runs.input:
I renewed once this morning, but my card shows two charges.
Please refund the duplicate.

runs.name: choose-split
runs.command: thinkthen choose --details 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < both.txt | jq -r '.answer.probabilities|tojson'
runs.input: You charged me twice and the package still has not shipped.

runs.name: choose-null
runs.command: thinkthen choose --threshold 0.9 'Which team owns this?' billing shipping account < both.txt
runs.input: You charged me twice and the package still has not shipped.
